name: The future of the boy's dormitory
steps: Take the dumbbell and give it to the boy working out.
Take the stock chart and give it to the boy at the desk.
Take the paint bucket and give it to the boy painting.
Take the casino chips and give them to the boy on the middle bunk.
Take the Buddha statue and give it to the boy on the lower bunk.
Take the mirror and give it to the boy on the top bunk.
Open the door to reveal the family man ending.
